intro: Animated characters with real physical motion: squash, stretch, impact and secondary motion, on the native Web Animations API. Play with one, then watch it react to an AI agent.

escenario.vistaAyuda: Silhouette hides the face, color and effects, so you judge the motion by its shape alone.
escenario.sinMovimiento: Motion is off. Turn it on in the header to play the gestures.

chat.intro: The bot is driven by streams shaped like the real SDKs (no model is called). They go through the same adapters and bindAgent you would use, so the bot answers each step with a gesture.
chat.mensajePorDefecto: How much does one icon weigh?
chat.respuesta: One icon is about 5.9 KB gzip. Bots are a separate entry point, so you only pay for them if you import them.
chat.vacio: Send a message and watch the assistant react.

simple.desc: The model just writes. No reasoning, no tools.

razonamiento.desc: The model thinks out loud first, then writes.

herramienta.desc: The model calls a tool, waits for the result and then answers.

paralelo.desc: Two tools in the same turn. The bot sees one tool step, not two.

herramientaFalla.nombre: A tool fails, the agent recovers
herramientaFalla.desc: The tool errors but the agent keeps going and answers anyway. It is not a stream error.

aprobacion.nombre: Waits for a person to approve
aprobacion.desc: A tool needs approval before it runs, so the bot waits longer than usual.

error.desc: The stream fails while the model is writing (rate limit, overload).

abortar.desc: The answer is cut short on purpose: the bot is released to rest.

traza.ayuda: Each line is an event of the stream and the step the adapter turned it into. A dash means it changes nothing.
traza.vacio: Send a message to see the stream.

fin.error: Stream error: it failed while answering. Nothing was changed.
fin.cortado: Cut off: you stopped it halfway.

codigo.titulo: The code behind what you see
codigo.descripcion: It changes as you pick a shape, a skin and a gesture.

peso.intro: Measured by the bundle check in CI, in KB gzip. You only pay for what you import.
peso.nota: Icons and bots are independent: installing one never loads the other.
